zh-CN.title: 欢迎语升级为欢迎消息
items: 可以像编辑聊天一样设置多条欢迎消息，并加入图片、视频、语音或文件
新好友接受申请后会按顺序自动收到；普通用户最多 3 条，永久 VIP 与官方账号最多 10 条

en.title: Welcome messages, upgraded
items: Build a multi-message greeting with text, images, video, audio, or files in a chat-style editor
New friends receive them in order after accepting; regular users get 3 slots, while permanent VIP and official accounts get 10
